name: Arabic Language Lab Suite
changelog: Fixed calls getting stuck on 'Connecting...' forever when camera/mic permission fails on either side
Call connection now always starts, even with no camera/mic access

Screen sharing now works in audio-only calls too
Broadcast: screen and webcam PiP no longer overwrite each other; late-joining cabins receive the live broadcast
Silent monitor: screen vs. webcam always shown in the right place
Quick login presets for Cabin 01-04 (4-cabin testing)
